suggestions: The skill correctly applied the Narrative-First protocol, scope-guard for Procedures, and double-bracket future-forward linking for deferred items.

eval_feedback.overall: Perfect pass (5/5). All structural expectations are met with strong evidence across multiple artifacts. The skill produced a well-connected knowledge graph with proper typing, categorized observations, revision tracking, and future-forward links for deferred work items.
